reason: The cited evidence discusses coercivity mechanisms in different alloy systems (FeCoNiSiAl CCA and FeCoNiMnCu film) and mentions pinning effects, but neither provides direct evidence that annealing single-phase fcc FeCoNi at 600–650 °C induces short-range ordering, nor that such ordering enhances anisotropy and coercivity in this specific system. The key premises lack specific prior support.
premises: Annealing at 600–650 °C induces short-range nanoscale chemical ordering in single-phase fcc FeCoNi
Such nano-domains enhance local magnetocrystalline anisotropy
Enhanced anisotropy creates domain wall pinning centers
Domain wall pinning significantly increases coercivity above 100 Oe
